title: The Expat's AI Edge - Free AI Tools to Build your Workflows | BrandBizkit
description: Stand out online with enterprise-level AI tools. Get started with free AI tools when launching your business or creating your brand. The Expat's AI Edge is your free guide to leverage the many AI tools that can build and automate your workflows and give you that competitive edge.
h1: Welcome to The Expat’s AI Edge!

blocks.text: Welcome to The Expat’s AI Edge!

We’re Karla Kangleon and Michael Nielsen. Together, we run the ExpatCareers Global Network and co-founded brandbizkit—two platforms with one shared mission: helping expats, founders, and entrepreneurs use AI to build stronger careers and businesses beyond borders.

We know how tough it can be: standing out online, launching something new, and keeping up with constant change—while also spending endless hours testing tools just to find what really works. With so much information out there, where do you even begin? That’s exactly why we created this first playbook as your introduction to leveraging the power of AI.

This is just the beginning. We’d love your feedback—what you think, what you need, and what would be most useful. Your input will guide the future resources we create for this community. And if you ever need help, just holler our way—we’re here for you.
Wanna learn how to use AI for your business?

We can help you get started using ChatGPT and other popular AI tools. If you already have some basic knowledge and understanding of AI we can also help you level up your game, teach you new ways using AI and enhance your output and productivity with super efficient prompts. Wanna know more about our next learning session click below and sign up.
